cells.api: Get/Set/Add/GetOrSet/Delete/ClearNamespace/Touch/Incr/Decr; GetMany/SetMany/DeleteMany; key prefix/version; TTL; compression codec
cells.behavior: Default Redis; local/dummy test doubles not production connectors. Clear never FLUSHALL. Increment and Add atomic; cache misses distinguished from outages.

cells.api: Per-site, per-view and template-fragment; Vary cookies/headers/language/site/auth scope; ETag/LastModified; Cache-Control
cells.behavior: Shared cache off for private authenticated content unless explicit identity-safe key policy; stale serve only opt-in with maximum age.

cells.api: Open/Save/Delete/Exists/List/Size/URL/ModifiedTime; collision strategy; upload chunk hooks; memory-to-temp-file threshold; file permissions and filename rules
cells.behavior: Local storage initial, streaming bound; private URL resolves via authenticated download; public files marked explicitly; orphan cleanup two-phase.

cells.api: SendMail/SendMassMail/MailAdmins/MailManagers; EmailMessage/Alternatives/attachments/CC/BCC/reply-to; SMTP connection pooling; console/file/in-memory/dummy for tests
cells.behavior: SMTP TLS verified, header injection rejected; accepted by SMTP is not delivery guarantee; error mode explicit; enqueue optional Async outbox.

cells.api: Debug/Info/Success/Warning/Error/custom levels; tags; minimum level; consume once; session/cookie/fallback storage
cells.behavior: Cookie size cap with session fallback; private content not placed in readable signed cookie; no cross-user shared cache.

cells.api: Message extraction/compile; gettext/pgettext/ngettext/lazy/context/plurals; translation override; language cookie and Accept-Language; JS catalog
cells.behavior: PO/MO-compatible catalog contract; source locale fallback; JavaScript catalog public strings only; formatting separate from parsing.

cells.api: Localized number/date formatting; aware instants, request timezone, UTC persistence; DST invalid/ambiguous input errors
cells.behavior: No process-global timezone mutation; clock injection for deterministic tests; display locale never changes stored values.

cells.api: JSON/JSONL/XML and registered safe codecs; natural keys; dependency order; dump/load; exclusions; streams; test fixtures
cells.behavior: Deserializers cannot instantiate arbitrary classes; explicit target alias and dry-run; IDs and permissions validated; destructive flush separate command.

cells.api: AppReady; model init/pre/post save/delete; m2m change; pre/post migrate; request start/finish/error; connection created; auth login/logout/failure; setting/test template signals; task lifecycle
cells.behavior: Typed event payloads; same-process only; stable receiver IDs; synchronous vs after-commit boundary explicit; no promise of durable event bus.

cells.api: Core dispatch port supports Enqueue and result handle; optional Async adapter provides full runtime; no backend enabled by default
cells.behavior: Includes Django6 task-family role without forcing Async dependency into Core; dummy/immediate backend only testing mode.

summary: Proposed contract for architecture review; not implemented.
